purpose: Train baseline U-Net/ResNet18 on the audited V4 training dataset combining legacy PV4GER data with 482 newly curated native NRW orthophoto partial masks (246 positive PV arrays and 236 PV-free roofs) to improve real-world generalization and transferability while maintaining benchmark accuracy.
checkpoint_selection: Highest internal validation pixel IoU on the untouched 278 validation crops. Retain best.pt and last.pt checkpoints with SHA-256 sidecars.
limitations: Validation uses the internal upstream-annotated holdout; no independent test set pixels are opened.
The 482 added NRW partial masks have sparse supervision (< 1% coverage of the new tiles) and rely on AI consensus proposals.
Hardware is an Apple M2 MacBook Air; batch size is kept at 2 to minimize memory pressure and thermal load.
